purpose: One batched, read-only gh api snapshot (repo state + latest release + HEAD commit, plus targeted tag lookups where releases are absent) for every repository the triage flags as needing a currency check across this unit's 7 layers, per the critic's cross_layer_checks id 'gh-api-upstream-currency-sweep' (OpenHands software-agent-sdk incl. reconciling its two cataloged revisions, context-hub, dagu, headroom, arize phoenix, inspect_ai, qmd, poppler/freedesktop mirror, markitdown, worktrunk, beads, gitleaks, syft, grype). Batched into one dated pass instead of per-layer reruns, as the critic instructed.
preregistered: Expected: for each of the 14 repositories, one `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>` call (pushed_at/archived/disabled), one `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/latest` call, and one `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/HEAD` call; a 404 on releases/latest for a repo would trigger a follow-up `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/tags` call to characterize currency without a Releases API. A newer upstream tag/release than the installed manifests/stack.json pin, for any of dagu/headroom/context-hub/qmd/worktrunk/beads/gitleaks/markitdown/syft, would extend or newly surface a currency gap; an exact match would reconfirm the pin is current. For OpenHands specifically, comparing HEAD and the latest release's target commit against both cataloged revisions (9bc452eb.../856d99d4...) would either reconcile them (if one now matches) or reconfirm both are stale (if neither matches) -- this does not by itself resolve which revision the catalog should adopt, only whether either is current. Run once per repository; no re-run to seek a different outcome.
